pages.title: Hyperspherical Ore
pages.text: Spheres in four dimensions leave odd traces when they intersect our three. This ore shows them as nested balls that swell and shrink as I turn the lump. It has no corners anywhere and rolls slightly uphill.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Slicing a 4-sphere with a 3-dimensional plane gives a growing then shrinking ball. In the ordinal stone I found ore whose cross-sections did exactly that as I rotated it. Something four-dimensional was buried here.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Transfinite Hierarchy (mine it for its drop).
